title: Accounts Receivable Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Credit & Collections Analyst to join our finance team. This role is ideal for professionals with a strong background in credit analysis, collections, and financial risk management who are passionate about driving transformation and automation within the finance function.


Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update customer account information in ERP systems based on documentation and internal controls.
  • Monitor and analyze credit limits and manage credit insurance processes.
  • Communicate with credit insurers to negotiate and secure approval for customer limits.
  • Foster strong client relationships through direct contact and collaboration with the sales team.
  • Analyze and process credit-hold orders for timely release and billing.
  • Monitor customer credit risk profiles and daily financial exposure.
  • Track and report on key metrics such as DSO, delinquency, and collections performance.
  • Manage and review customer deductions and rebates.
  • Develop and maintain financial and performance dashboards using Excel and Power BI.
  • Support both internal and external audit processes with relevant documentation.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and implement solutions using tools such as Power Automate, VBA, macros, and AI technologies.
  • Assist in strategic projects aimed at process improvement and digital transformation within the credit & collections function.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Credit and Collections;
  • Advanced Excel skills (including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and dashboards);
  • Knowledge of AItools (e.G., Copilot, ChatGPT), Power BI, dashboards, and data analytics;
  • Experience in financial statement and income statement (P&L) analysis;
  • Advanced English proficiency;
  • Experience in process automation;
  • Experience withERP systems;
  • Familiarity with key indicators and KPIs such as DSO, delinquency rate, aging list, among others.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Project leadership experience, particularly in system or process implementation.
  • Prior experience in the consumer goods (FMCG) sector.
  • Familiarity with CRM and digital collections platforms.

title: Managing Director
description:
About Us

XCELiS is made up of a team of Supply Chain specialists with over 15 years of experience optimizing and transforming business results in Brazil and abroad.

We operate end-to-end across the supply chain, from design to implementation, delivering performance optimization and results-driven projects in areas such as Logistics Network, Transportation, Warehousing, Planning, E-Commerce/Omnichannel, Procurement, Technology, and Control Tower.

We are certified in Organizational Climate by FEEx 2023 and 2024, recognized as leaders in Supply Chain Advisory and Consulting Services and as Contender in the Supply Chain IT Operation Services quadrant of the ISG Provider Lens™ Supply Chain Services Brazil 2023 study. In addition, we were awarded 1st place by INBRASC in 2023 in the categories Logistics Consulting and TMS Provider .


Job descripiton:

The Managing Director in Supply Chain Transformation at XCELiS is a senior, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader responsible for expanding new business and leading end-to-end supply chain transformation projects. This professional will combine deep expertise in logistics, planning (S&OP), procurement, and digital technologies. The goal is to position XCELiS as the leading consulting firm in supply chain solutions, delivering measurable value, pragmatism, resilience, competitive advantage, and results for our clients.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Market Strategy

  • Manage the financial performance (P&L) of projects in partnership with the finance team.
  • Lead the prospecting of complex Supply Chain projects, from diagnosis to the implementation of S&OP, logistics, and digitalization solutions.
  • Act as the primary advisor to C-level clients (CSCO, COO, CEO), translating their business challenges into robust supply chain strategies.
  • Develop and price value propositions that clearly demonstrate ROI, focusing on cost optimization, service improvement, and risk mitigation.
  • Represent XCELiS in the Supply Chain ecosystem by speaking at events, publishing articles, and building a strong professional network.

Leadership and Delivery of Supply Chain Projects

  • Oversee the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring the application of best practices in demand planning, inventory management, logistics network optimization, and automation.
  • Provide final review and strategic guidance to project teams, ensuring solutions are not only theoretical but also practical and high-impact.
  • Manage the inherent challenges of transformation projects, such as change management, system integration (ERP, WMS, TMS), and stakeholder alignment.
  • Lead and mentor a team of specialized Supply Chain consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Identify emerging trends (AI in logistics, blockchain, sustainability in supply chains) and develop new service offerings for XCELiS.


Qualifications and Competencies

Academic Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, etc.), Business Administration, or Economics.
  • Postgraduate degree, MBA, Master’s, or PhD with a focus on Supply Chain or Logistics is highly desirable.


Technical Skills (Supply Chain)

  • End-to-end supply chain expertise: Planning (S&OP/IBP), Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics (Transportation and Warehousing), and Customer Service.
  • Proven experience leading logistics network optimization projects, distribution center design, TMS/WMS implementation, and inventory management strategies.


Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Meal voucher (iFood)
  • iFood Club
  • Cost allowance
  • Health insurance
  • Dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Birthday day off
  • TotalPass (well-being and gym access)
  • Travel assistance
  • Avus (affordable medical appointments and exams, telemedicine, 24h medical support, and discounts on medications)
  • Development program
  • Partnerships with universities and language schools (discounts available)
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave

description:

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the optimization and digital transformation of the collections function through data-driven decision-making and automation initiatives.

  • Manage a portfolio of overdue accounts, ensuring daily follow-up on delinquencies.
  • Negotiate payment plans and methods with clients, prioritizing strategic and respectful recovery.
  • Monitor and update accounts receivable information in the ERP system.
  • Build and maintain performance reports (aging list, delinquency trends, collection KPIs) using Excel and Power BI.
  • Support internal and external audits with accurate and timely documentation.
  • Automate routine collection and reporting processes using tools such as Power Automate, VBA, macros, or RPA.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Sales, Legal, Credit Insurance, and Customer Service to ensure alignment on collection strategies.
  • Analyze credit and collection KPIs to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to the development and revision of internal policies and procedures for credit and collections.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields;
  • Previous experience in Collections and/or Credit;
  • Required: Familiarity with AI tools (e.G., Copilot, ChatGPT), Power BI, and dashboards;
  • Advanced Excel skills (including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and dashboards);
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ERP systems

title: Enfermeira Geriátrica Sênior
description:
Sobre a Kuidar+

A Kuidar+ é uma healthtech em rápido crescimento que está transformando o cuidado em demência no Brasil. Nossa missão é clara: oferecer mais dias bons ao paciente, apoiar o cuidador e reduzir custos. Unimos tecnologia, expertise médica e suporte contínuo ao cuidador. Inspirados em modelos já validados nos EUA e adaptados à realidade brasileira, estamos construindo uma solução pioneira onde impacto social e inovação em saúde caminham juntos. Reporta-se a: Geriatra Responsável


Descrição da Vaga

title: Sales Executive
description:
Location: Remote South America (Central Time Zone - USA. 8am - 5pm)

Compensation (Brazil): R$4000/month + Commission.


We’re a high-growth recruiting firm trusted by mid-market and venture-backed companies to deliver top-tier talent in Technology, Product Management, and Executive Search. Our model spans contract, contract-to-hire, and direct hire placements, offering clients flexibility, speed, and culture-aligned hiring solutions.


Our sales team is the tip of the spear. We're looking for a Senior Sales Development Representative to help us accelerate growth by setting qualified meetings with decision-makers at fast-moving companies.


The Role


As a Senior SDR, you’ll be responsible for creating high-quality opportunities for our Managing Director through proactive outbound outreach across multiple channels. Your mission: generate meaningful conversations with hiring leaders at mid-market companies (100–5,000 employees) across the U.S.

This role is high-volume, phone-led, and metrics-driven—best suited for someone who thrives in a high-energy environment and knows how to position consulting services in a competitive market.


What You'll Do

  • Own the top of the funnel for all outbound activity across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Research and segment leads using ZoomInfo, Crelate, and LinkedIn Premium
  • Execute 100 –120+ cold calls/day, plus daily targeted emails and LinkedIn messaging
  • Book qualified meetings with decision-makers (typically VPs, Directors, and Founders)
  • Track activity and pipeline through SourceWhale and internal CRM systems
  • Partner closely with the Managing Director to ensure meeting quality and ICP alignment
  • Iterate and improve outreach campaigns based on performance metrics and conversion data


What We're Looking For

  • 2–5+ years of SDR experience in a B2B consulting or staffing/recruiting environment
  • Proven success generating meetings with mid-market U.S. clients
  • Mastery of cold calling and sales engagement tools (SourceWhale, ZoomInfo, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of professional services, especially in technology, product, or executive search
  • Confident, curious, and motivated by the challenge of breaking into new accounts
  • Comfortable with high daily activity targets and KPI-driven accountability
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills


What You’ll Get

  • Base salary + bonuses with uncapped earning potential
  • Daily mentorship from a Managing Director with deep industry experience
  • Flexible, remote-first work culture with outcome-driven autonomy
  • Access to best-in-class tools to power your outreach and workflow
  • Opportunity to grow into a full-cycle sales or account management role

description:

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

Tableau, Power BI and Qlik

Temos em nosso DNA o interesse genuíno pelas pessoas, seja dentro da cooperativa – o que nos levou a conquistar 16 premiações em rankings regionais e nacionais do Great Place to Work (GPTW) -, ou junto aos nossos associados, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas e com taxas justas. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

Please note this is a 6-month fixed-term contract role.


The Opportunity

Are you passionate about recruiting top talent for Tech and Product roles? Join our global business at Cint as a Talent Acquisition Partner, where you will support our R&D (Tech and Product) teams. Our Talent Acquisition (TA) function is critical to our success, as it enables us to attract and hire the right talent that drives our business forward. In this role, you will proactively manage the recruitment process, working closely with business leaders to attract and hire the best candidates for our commercial and finance functions.


The Team

You will be part of an established global TA team comprising both technical and non-technical recruiters. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, where we support one another, share information, and celebrate successes. We continuously evaluate and improve our processes to ensure we remain at the forefront of talent acquisition.

Join us at Cint and be a part of a dynamic team that plays a vital role in our global success. If you are ready to take on the challenge and drive the recruitment of top technical talent, apply now!


What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead and execute the entire recruitment process for roles within our Tech and Product functions.
  • Consultative Partnership: Work closely with hiring managers, People Partners, and Finance Partners to share industry trends, compensation insights, and competitor updates.
  • Educate Hiring Managers: Provide guidance on best practices, recruitment strategies, and process improvements to enhance their hiring practices.
  • End-to-End Process Management: Manage all aspects of the hiring process, including writing job advertisements, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, arranging interviews, and extending job offers.
  • ATS Management: Maintain and update our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) – SmartRecruiters.
  • Support DEI: Promote and support Cint’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Engage in projects with the TA team to implement process changes that enhance our ability to identify and attract talent.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Analyze your performance metrics to identify strengths and areas for development, and share these insights with the team.
Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: Proven experience in a talent acquisition/recruiting role, managing end-to-end recruitment for commercial vacancies in Brazil/North America.
  • Commercial & Finance Insight: Understanding the importance of the Tech/Engineering and Product functions within a global business.
  • ATS Proficiency: Ability to maintain and manage an accurate ATS.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Ability to analyze performance metrics and use data to drive recruitment strategies.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong team player who can collaborate effectively to address challenges and develop solutions.
  • Proactive Sourcing: Willingness to source candidates proactively to find the right expertise.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • ATS Experience: Previous experience using the Smart Recruiters ATS.
Additional Information


Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

    every opinion matters

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

Gerente Sênior de Produto e Inovação


A Linus é uma marca que tem como propósito tornar o bem-estar um estilo de vida , por meio de escolhas práticas e conscientes. Por isso, se você quer fazer parte de um amanhã mais sustentável - ambiental, social e financeiramente - questionando o status-quo de maneira colaborativa e ética, esta vaga é para você.


sobre a posição


Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de produto, inovação e gestão de portfólio, capaz de unir visão criativa e raciocínio estratégico. Esta posição será responsável por liderar todo o ciclo de vida dos produtos — do conceito à produção — garantindo coerência com o posicionamento de marca e os pilares de sustentabilidade da Linus.


O papel envolve liderança técnica e criativa nas frentes de calçados, acessórios e embalagens, atuando de forma integrada com as áreas de Branding, Comercial e Operações para impulsionar a inovação, eficiência e consistência de portfólio.


quais serão suas responsabilidades?


1) gestão de portfólio e criação de produto


  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de coleções de calçados e acessórios, definindo cartela de cores, design e mix de produtos.
  • Conduzir pesquisas de tendência, inovação de materiais e análise de mercado, garantindo produtos alinhados ao branding e à sustentabilidade da marca.
  • Aprovar conceitos e criações em parceria com CEO, áreas Comercial e Marketing, assegurando coerência e identidade.
  • Gerenciar custos e margens de produtos, definir pirâmide de portfólio e estratégias de precificação.


2) desenvolvimento de produto e inovação técnica


  • Liderar as etapas de P&D e Qualidade, acompanhando testes de materiais, formulações e desempenho técnico dos produtos.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com fornecedores e ecossistema de inovação para explorar novas tecnologias e matérias-primas sustentáveis.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de especificações técnicas, desempenho e qualidade dos produtos desenvolvidos.


3) design e modelagem de produto


  • Liderar as etapas de design e modelamento 3D do produto, desde a escolha de forma, aprovação de calce e matrizaria, garantindo o alinhamento entre criação, fornecedores e parceiros.
  • Avaliar custos e investimentos de moldes, acompanhando a viabilidade técnica e financeira de cada novo produto.
  • Garantir que os produtos mantenham o padrão de conforto, estética e durabilidade característicos da Linus.


4) desenvolvimento de embalagens


  • Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de embalagens (caixas, tags, sacolas e insumos), alinhadas à identidade visual da marca.
  • Equilibrar materiais sustentáveis e viabilidade técnica, garantindo soluções que expressem os valores da Linus.


5) gestão de projetos e processos


  • Estruturar e acompanhar cronogramas de desenvolvimento, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e entregas de produção no CD.
  • Implementar processos e boas práticas que assegurem integração entre times e fluidez de informações entre áreas.


6) collabs e parcerias


  • Fomentar oportunidades de inovação e diferenciação por meio de collabs, parcerias e cocriações com marcas, designers e parceiros.
  • Promover um pipeline contínuo de ideias e referências que mantenham a Linus na vanguarda do design sustentável.


quem estamos procurando?


1) formação acadêmica


  • Graduação em Design de Produto, Engenharia de Materiais, Moda ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Inovação, Sustentabilidade ou Gestão de Produto será considerada um diferencial.


2) experiência prévia


  • Experiência consolidada em desenvolvimento de produto e gestão de portfólio no segmento de moda, calçados ou bens de consumo.
  • Vivência em P&D e inovação de materiais sustentáveis.
  • Experiência com gestão de fornecedores, custos e cronogramas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuação anterior em empresas com foco em design autoral, branding e sustentabilidade será um diferencial.


3) habilidades técnicas e comportamentais


  • Domínio de ferramentas de design e modelagem 3D.
  • Boa visão de negócio e entendimento de indicadores de margem e rentabilidade.
  • Perfil criativo, organizado e colaborativo.
  • Capacidade de equilibrar estética, funcionalidade e viabilidade técnica.
  • Mentalidade inovadora e afinidade com temas de sustentabilidade e propósito.


o que oferecemos?

title: Principal Software Engineer - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.

Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our international Data Solutions & Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, scaling, and maintenance of the code that powers our production systems. You will work autonomously, providing technical direction and ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across multiple projects. You will proactively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product and Data Science, to drive strategic initiatives. With significant freedom to innovate, you will play a pivotal role in world-class research, shaping the next generation of Cint products and mentoring less experienced engineers.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on professional backend software development experience, with a significant portion in a leadership or principal role.

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Proficient programming skills in Python or Java and comfortable maintaining code in both languages, with a strong emphasis on architectural design and code quality.

  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, advanced testing frameworks, and deployment strategies.

  • Extensive experience with complex API integration, design, and best practices, including defining API standards.

  • Expertise in dealing with system complexity, distributed systems, and large-scale architectural challenges.

  • Exceptional sense of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

  • Outstanding problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills.

  • Consistently questions the status quo and brings innovative, impactful solutions to engineering and product needs, driving significant technical advancements.

  • Strong ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across multiple teams, ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-efficient solutions that align with business objectives.

  • Enjoys working as part of a team, actively mentoring and guiding other engineers, and providing constructive feedback to foster growth.

  • Comfortable with making critical decisions based on comprehensive data analysis and industry best practices.

  • Outstanding communication skills to guide and facilitate complex cross-functional collaboration and present technical strategies to diverse audiences.

  • Extensive background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar, with experience in designing and optimizing data pipelines.

  • Deep familiarity with observability strategies, including advanced monitoring, logging, and tracing.

  • Extensive experience with AWS, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and advanced SQL, including database design and performance tuning.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen;
    every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. ( />


Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

    elaborar relatórios e apresentações executivas.

Formação: Graduação em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

description:
Sobre a MAPFRE


Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo? Presente desde 1992 no Brasil, atuamos com Investimentos, Consórcios, Capitalização, Previdência e Vida Resgatável, Saúde, Seguros e Assistência.


Nosso compromisso com a sociedade


Aqui na MAPFRE contribuímos para uma sociedade mais sustentável, solidária e inclusiva. Temos o compromisso em apoiar diversidade, construindo um ambiente com igualdade e equidade. Valorizamos e apoiamos a presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de pessoa com deficiência e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero em nossas equipes.


Essa é a nossa pegada! Gostou? Confira os detalhes da vaga abaixo:


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?


Responsável por analisar, monitorar e otimizar os resultados comerciais relacionados aos produtos de seguro. Ele contribui diretamente para o crescimento sustentável da empresa, por meio da identificação de oportunidades, desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho comercial relacionados à todos os ramos de seguro, identificando tendências e oportunidades.
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais e dashboards analíticos para suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica.
  • Identificar e propor melhorias nos processos comerciais, visando aumento de eficiência e rentabilidade.
  • Colaborar com equipes de vendas na definição de metas, estratégias de atuação e acompanhamento de resultados.
  • Participar de projetos de desenvolvimento, aprimoramento e lançamento de novos produtos de seguro.
  • Realizar benchmarking e estudos de mercado para embasar estratégias comerciais, incluindo mapeamento do mercado e suas principais parcerias com data de aproximação para prospecção.
  • Apoiar na definição de campanhas de incentivo e ações promocionais.
  • Interagir com áreas técnicas e atuariais para alinhamento de rentabilidade e performance dos produtos.
  • Habilidade na extração e gestão de dados que nos oriente na tomada de decisões, comprovando tendencias e padrões
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de grande volume de dados, permitindo recomendar as melhores soluções para o momento da diretoria.
  • Apoiar o time comercial na geração de relatórios, dashs e demais templates com informações relevantes sobre odesempenho mensal, trimestral, anual.


O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ


Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Atuária ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em análise de desempenho comercial no setor de seguros.

Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel, Power BI, SQL, etc.).

Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e foco em resultados.

Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para atuação com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Espanhol avançado será considerado um diferencial.


Local de trabalho: SÃO PAULO / SP (3X2)


Nossos benefícios para você


A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.


Nos importamos com o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores e para isso, trabalhamos programas que promovem mobilidade, desenvolvimento, oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional. title: Software Engineer
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is building an AI Doctor to radically improve healthcare. We recently raised the largest LatAm seed round of $9M, backed by top global investors. Our team comes from Stanford, Microsoft, MD Anderson, Houston Methodist, and Alice, and we’re on a mission to transform how clinical data is captured and used.

Healthcare has two fundamental sources of truth: images and conversations. While most technology has focused on images, 99% of real medical decisions are made through voice. Telepatia is capturing that voice data and turning it into structured, reliable clinical intelligence—unlocking the foundation for an AI-first healthcare system.

We are assembling one of the most talent-dense technical teams in Latin America, with the ambition of building the “Manhattan Project” of AI in healthcare.


Mission of the Role

As a Software Engineer at Telepatia, your mission is to transform cutting-edge AI research into production systems that can handle thousands of concurrent clinical sessions with reliability, speed, and trust. You’ll own critical pieces of our infrastructure—from backend microservices and data pipelines to lightweight front-ends—ensuring that our product feels both magical and bulletproof to the doctors who use it daily.

You’ll be part of a small, elite team where each engineer’s output directly impacts product velocity, client trust, and ultimately, patient care across Latin America. This is a role for builders who thrive in high-ownership environments and want to ship fast in the most meaningful vertical there is: healthcare.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and scale backend systems (Python/Typescript) that support real-time transcription, structured data capture, and AI-powered clinical workflows.
  • Build and maintain lightweight front-ends (Flutter) to deliver seamless user experiences for doctors.
  • Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and AI engineers to turn ambiguous requests into production features—often in less than a day.
  • Contribute to technical decisions around infra, cost models, observability, and scalability as we grow from dozens to thousands of simultaneous users
  • Collaborate with AI Team doing LLM orchestration and AI agent pipelines and integrating that into our core Medical Scribe product


Must-Haves

  • Strong experience in backend and/or full-stack development
  • Ability to work across the stack and ship full features end-to-end when needed
  • Startup mindset: scrappy, fast, and biased toward action. You enjoy turning ambiguity into production systems quickly
  • High product velocity: you care about impact and speed, not just elegant code
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a high-ownership role


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with AI application layer (LLM orchestration, LangChain, vector DBs, eval pipelines)
  • Experience with healthcare tech (EHR integrations, HIPAA/LGPD compliance)
  • Prior startup experience in high-growth

  • Realizar auditorias nacionais e internacionais em fornecedores, de acordo com Programa de Qualificação estabelecido, em uma frequência suficiente que possa determinar se o fornecedor está em conformidade com procedimentos e legislações e apto a fornecer materiais e serviços à Apsen.


  • Planejar e ministrar treinamentos definidos na matriz de treinamentos relacionados à atividades de qualidade, a fim de capacitar os colaboradores e prestadores de serviços que executam atividades relacionadas aos procedimentos de qualidade, bem como garantir que os novos funcionários compreendam as Boas Práticas de Fabricação e demais legislações vigentes para produtos para saúde animal.

description:

title: Desenvolvedor Sênior - Especialista Em Integração De Ia E Aws
description:
Procuramos um Desenvolvedor Sênior para atuar na vanguarda da integração de inteligência artificial, machine learning e Amazon Connect em sistemas corporativos. O profissional será a peça-chave na criação de experiências de atendimento inteligentes, personalizadas e autônomas, conectando soluções de IA a plataformas legadas e modernas.


Sua principal responsabilidade será projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações robustas entre o Amazon Connect, serviços de IA da AWS (como Bedrock e Amazon Q) e outras aplicações de negócio, como CRMs, ERPs e bancos de dados. O foco do trabalho será a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de APIs REST, utilizando tanto AWS Lambda quanto containers (Docker) para orquestrar fluxos complexos, garantindo a performance, segurança e escalabilidade das soluções.


Responsabilidades do Cargo:


  • Desenvolver integrações de alta complexidade entre o Amazon Connect, serviços de IA/ML da AWS (Amazon Bedrock e Amazon Q) e outras plataformas de negócio, utilizando principalmente APIs REST.
  • Projetar e criar funções AWS Lambda e construir e manter containers (Docker) para orquestrar fluxos de atendimento, automatizar processos e integrar com sistemas externos (CRMs, ERPs, bancos de dados).
  • Projetar e implementar contact flows inteligentes no Amazon Connect, com roteamento contextual e fallback com IA.
  • Aplicar lógica de IA generativa e modelos de linguagem natural (LLMs) via Amazon Bedrock para interagir com clientes em tempo real, gerando respostas, resumos e classificações.
  • Atuar ativamente na modernização de contact centers legados, implementando componentes de IA em ambientes híbridos, apoiando processos de lift-and-shift e refactoring.
  • Apoiar o time de forma técnica na resolução de problemas (troubleshooting), testes e na melhoria contínua das soluções.
  • Criar documentação técnica detalhada dos fluxos, integrações e modelos utilizados.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência sênior comprovada em desenvolvimento de software com foco em integrações de sistemas, especialmente via APIs.
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento com AWS Lambda, APIs REST e arquitetura serverless (Node.Js e/ou Python).
  • Sólida experiência na criação e gestão de containers com Docker.
  • Conhecimento avançado e prático de serviços de orquestração de containers, como ECS ou EKS.
  • Conhecimento avançado nos principais serviços da AWS (DynamoDB, S3, SNS, SQS), com foco em IA/ML, sendo Amazon Bedrock um requisito mandatório.
  • Experiência com boas práticas de segurança em nuvem (IAM, etc.).
  • Habilidade para construir soluções robustas, escaláveis e seguras.
  • Experiência com sistemas de versionamento como Git.
  • Formação superior completa.


Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Experiência com Amazon Connect ou outras plataformas de comunicação, como Nice ou Genesys.
  • Experiência com outros serviços AWS de IA/ML, como Lex, Transcribe, Translate, Polly ou Sagemaker.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas lift-and-shift, ambientes híbridos e modernizações.
  • Experiência com modernização de sistemas legados.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.

Noções de protocolos de rede e análise de tráfego.

Capacidade de desenvolver casos de uso de segurança com base em riscos e ameaças.

title: Representante Comercial Compras
description:
Representante Comercial – Empresa de Reciclaje de tarjetas electrónicas, chatarra ferrosa y no ferrosa


Ubicación: Región de São Paulo, Brasil

Empresa: BG Metal Trade Inc.

Descripción del cargo

BG Metal Trade busca un Representante Comercial para liderar la expansión y gestión del área de compras de materiales reciclables en Brasil, con enfoque en la región de São Paulo.

El profesional será responsable de desarrollar relaciones comerciales sólidas con proveedores de chatarra, captar empresas que desean descartar materiales del rubro fortalecer la presencia de la empresa en el mercado brasileño de reciclaje industrial y corporativo.


Responsabilidades principales

  • Realizar visitas semanales a proveedores para verificación de inventario, cierre de compras o promover relaciones comerciales.
  • Prospectar nuevos proveedores a través de visitas, y identificar quien son los recicladores importantes de cada región.
  • Prospectar empresas corporativas para ofrecer soluciones de reciclaje de materiales que desean descartar.
  • Negociar condiciones comerciales, asegurando márgenes competitivos y rentabilidad.
  • Realizar seguimiento de los contratos cerrados y supervisar procesos de inspección y cargue de material.
  • Elaborar reportes mensuales de precios de mercado (chatarra electrónica y metales) y proponer estrategias de compra según las tendencias.
  • Asegurar que todas las operaciones y contratos cumplan con los procedimientos establecidos bajo la norma ISO 9001.
  • Reportes semanales de las actividades realizadas a la Gerencia Comercial.


Requisitos del puesto

Educación:

  • Titulación universitaria en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Comercio Internacional o áreas afines.

Experiencia:

  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia comprobada en la industria metalmecánica o de reciclaje industrial.

Conocimientos técnicos:

  • Dominio de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel y PowerPoint.
  • Conocimiento de normas ISO 9001 y su aplicación en procesos de compra y control de calidad.
  • Capacidad analítica para evaluación de precios de mercado, y toma de decisiones.

Competencias y habilidades:

  • Excelentes habilidades de negociación, comunicación y manejo de relaciones comerciales.
  • Alta proactividad y organización
  • Capacidad de trabajo bajo presión y cumplimiento de metas.
  • Fluidez en portugués, español e inglés (oral y escrito).
  • Disponibilidad para viajar dentro del país y en el estado de São Paulo.
